bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const h={Authorization:"Bearer "+process.env.AI_CORE_API_KEY};(async()=>{for(const [port,model] of [[18185,"/models/Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf"],[18186,"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"]]){let r=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:"+port+"/v1/models",{headers:h,signal:AbortSignal.timeout(5000)});if(!r.ok)process.exit(31);let j=await r.json();if(j.data?.[0]?.id!==model)process.exit(32);}console.log("QWEN_AND_DEEPSEEK_GATE_IDENTITY_PASS");})().catch(()=>process.exit(33));'
